metadata.question: Does the sea surface temperature in the eastern tropical Pacific decrease in November 2021, compared with the long-term average during November?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about sea surface temperature (SST) in the eastern tropical Pacific for November 2021 compared to the long-term November average. 1. Search Strategy: - Collection: MODIS Aqua SST data (MODISA_L3_SST) is good for SST analysis - Location: Eastern tropical Pacific - I'll define a polygon covering this region - Time: November 2021 vs long-term November average (I'll use 2000-2020 as reference period) 2. Masking Strategy: - For SST data, I'll need to mask poor quality pixels using the quality flags 3. Logic: - Calculate mean SST for November 2021 - Calculate mean SST for long-term November average (2000-2020) - Compare if 2021 is lower than long-term average - Check for data availability and valid pixels I'll use MODIS Aqua SST data which has good spatial coverage and quality flags. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define eastern tropical Pacific region var roi = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-150, 20], [-80, 20], [-80, -20], [-150, -20], [-150, 20]] ]); // Function to process MODIS SST data function processSST(collection) { return collection .filterBounds(roi) .select('sst') .map(function(image) { // Convert from Kelvin to Celsius and mask poor quality var sst = image.select('sst').multiply(0.0001).subtract(273.15); return sst.updateMask(sst.gt(-5).and(sst.lt(40))); // Reasonable SST range }); } // Get November 2021 SST var nov2021 = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI') .filterDate('2021-11-01', '2021-11-30'); var nov2021_processed = processSST(nov2021); // Get long-term November average (2000-2020) var longterm = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI') .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(11, 11, 'month')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2000, 2020, 'year')); var longterm_processed = processSST(longterm); // Check data availability var count2021 = nov2021_processed.size().getInfo(); var countLongterm = longterm_processed.size().getInfo(); print(`2021 November images: ${count2021}`); print(`Long-term November images: ${countLongterm}`); if (count2021 === 0 || countLongterm === 0) { print("C1"); return; } // Calculate means var mean2021 = nov2021_processed.mean(); var meanLongterm = longterm_processed.mean(); // Check valid pixels var count2021_pixels = mean2021.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('sst').getInfo(); var countLongterm_pixels = meanLongterm.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('sst').getInfo(); print(`2021 valid pixels: ${count2021_pixels}`); print(`Long-term valid pixels: ${countLongterm_pixels}`); if (count2021_pixels === 0 || countLongterm_pixels === 0) { print("C2"); return; } // Calculate SST values var sst2021 = mean2021.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: roi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('sst').getInfo(); var sstLongterm = meanLongterm.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: roi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('sst').getInfo(); print(`2021 SST: ${sst2021?.toFixed(2)}°C`); print(`Long-term SST: ${sstLongterm?.toFixed(2)}°C`); print(`Difference: ${(sst2021 - sstLongterm)?.toFixed(2)}°C`); // Validate results if (sst2021 === null || sstLongterm === null || isNaN(sst2021) || isNaN(sstLongterm) || sst2021 < -5 || sst2021 > 40 || sstLongterm < -5 || sstLongterm > 40) { print("C3"); return; } // Check if 2021 SST is lower than long-term average if (sst2021 < sstLongterm) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
